\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{booktabs,siunitx,mathtools}
\sisetup{group-minimum-digits=5}
\DeclareSIUnit{\speed}{\kilo\metre\per\second}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\norm}{\lVert}{\rVert}
\newcommand{\sample}[1]{\num{#1}}
\newcommand{\named}[1][Sample]{\textbf{#1}}
\DeclareRobustCommand{\RR}{\ensuremath{\mathbb{R}}}
\newcommand{\constant}{1.20e-3}

\begin{document}
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{lr}
\toprule
项目 & 数值 \\
\midrule
Alpha & \num{1234.56} \\
Beta & \num{42} \\
\named & \sample{12345.600} \\
Speed & \qty{3.00e2}{\speed} \\
Domain & \RR \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

\[
  \num{\constant},\quad
  \SI{9.81}{\metre\per\second\squared},\quad
  \num[output-decimal-marker={,}]{1234.56},\quad
  \norm*{\frac{x}{y}}
\]

\[
  \numlist{1;2;3},\quad \numrange{1e3}{2e3},\quad

\]

\[
  \num[round-mode=places,round-precision=2]{1.23456},\quad

  \qty[per-mode=fraction]{9.81}{\metre\per\second\squared}
\]
